name: TC-903: a debit card is NOT charged the processing fee
description: Fee ON → place a wind order with a Stripe DEBIT test card. Surcharging debit/prepaid is barred, so finalize-surcharge drops the fee before the charge: the stored order has processingFee 0 and a total below the credit quote.
